mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_deletion_task( asset_type, asset_id, relative_path, owner_user_id, file_size, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{assetType}, #{assetId}, #{relativePath}, #{ownerUserId}, #{fileSize}, 'PENDING', 0, COALESCE(#{nextRetryAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE relative_path = VALUES(relative_path), owner_user_id = VALUES(owner_user_id), file_size = VALUES(file_size), status = 'PENDING', next_retry_at = COALESCE(VALUES(next_retry_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_deletion_task WHERE asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId}
SELECT * FROM file_deletion_task WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM file_deletion_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_retry_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE file_deletion_task SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
